runs.config:
title = loom benchmark [r0-ghostty]
font-family = Menlo
font-size = 10
font-feature = -liga
font-feature = -calt
window-width = 100
window-height = 30
window-padding-x = 0
window-padding-y = 0
window-save-state = never
window-inherit-working-directory = false
window-inherit-font-size = false
cursor-style-blink = false
scrollback-limit = 10000000
shell-integration = none
quit-after-last-window-closed = true
background-opacity = 1
macos-titlebar-style = native

visibility_confirmation.method: Automatic foreground on launch, per user instruction; no per-window confirmation
visibility_confirmation.visibility_limit: Foreground assumed from user-observed launch behavior; not independently monitored
